classification.difficultyReason: Calculate unknowns in the requested order by linking parallel-line and point-angle facts with brief reasons.

content.prompt: Calculate the values of the unknown angles in alphabetical order. Give a brief reason.

spec.description: Shallow rising transversal meeting two terminal, parallel downward-left arms. Single downward markers; no dots or angle arcs.
spec.mathematics: 65° and a° are corresponding sectors. At the right vertex a° and b° are adjacent on a straight line.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 65°, a° and b° are visible in the question.

answer.short:
$a=65^\circ$ (corresponding angles on parallel lines).

$b=115^\circ$ (angles on a straight line).
answer.worked:
$a=65^\circ$ (corresponding angles on parallel lines).

Angles on a straight line:
$$\begin{align*}b+65&=180\\b&=115\end{align*}$$
$b=115^\circ$.

spec.description: Two complete oblique lines and one additional steep upper-left ray. An unfilled right-angle square joins the added ray and upper-right arm.
spec.mathematics: Clockwise sectors from the added ray are 90°, e, 120°, f, g. Opposite arms remain collinear.
spec.answerVisibility: Only e, f, g, 120° and the right-angle marker are visible in the question.

answer.short:
$e=60^\circ$ (angles on a straight line).

$f=60^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).

$g=30^\circ$ (angles in a right angle).
answer.worked:

$$\begin{align*}e+120&=180\\e&=60\end{align*}$$
$e=60^\circ$.

$f=60^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).

Angles in a right angle:
$$\begin{align*}g+60&=90\\g&=30\end{align*}$$
$g=30^\circ$.

spec.description: Three complete concurrent lines with an unfilled right-angle square in the upper sector.
spec.mathematics: Clockwise sectors from the steep upper-left arm: 90°, w, x, y, z, 50°. Each opposite arm pair is collinear.
spec.answerVisibility: Only w, x, y, z, 50° and the right-angle marker are visible in the question.

answer.short:

$x=50^\circ$, $y=90^\circ$, $z=40^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).
answer.worked:

$$\begin{align*}50+90+w&=180\\w+140&=180\\w&=40\end{align*}$$
$w=40^\circ$.

$x=50^\circ$ (vertically opposite to the given $50^\circ$).

$y=90^\circ$ (vertically opposite to the marked right angle).

$z=40^\circ$ (vertically opposite to $w$).

spec.description: Triangle with top vertex A, right vertex B and bottom vertex C; modelling names are not printed. BC extends through C toward lower-left. An upper-left ray from C is parallel to AB, with matching down-right markers.
spec.mathematics: A=38° and B=90°. Coordinate construction makes AB perpendicular to BC and the added ray parallel to AB. At C, j lies between CA and the added ray; k lies between that ray and the extension of BC; l is interior. No side lengths are introduced.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 38°, j, k, l, parallel markers and the right-angle square are visible in the question.

answer.short:
$j=38^\circ$ (alternate angles on parallel lines).

$k=90^\circ$ (corresponding angles on parallel lines).

$l=52^\circ$ (angles on a straight line).
answer.worked:
$j=38^\circ$ (alternate angles on parallel lines).

$k=90^\circ$ (corresponding angles on parallel lines).

Angles on a straight line:
$$\begin{align*}j+k+l&=180\\38+90+l&=180\\128+l&=180\\l&=52\end{align*}$$
$l=52^\circ$.

spec.answerVisibility: Only 104°, q and two r labels with the matching parallel markers are visible in the question.

answer.short:
$q=76^\circ$ (co-interior angles between parallel lines).

$2r=104^\circ$ (corresponding angles on parallel lines).

$r=52^\circ$.
answer.worked:
Co-interior angles between parallel lines:
$$\begin{align*}q+104&=180\\q&=76\end{align*}$$
$q=76^\circ$.

Corresponding angles on parallel lines:
$$\begin{align*}2r&=104\\r&=52\end{align*}$$
$r=52^\circ$.

spec.description: Triangle between two extended horizontal parallel lines. Apex lies on the upper line and base lies on the lower line. Each line carries a right-pointing parallel marker.
spec.mathematics: Base angles are 67° and 42°. Coordinates use a free drawing height and cotangents of the given base angles. Apex sectors below the upper line are q, r, p from left to right. No side lengths are given or printed.
spec.answerVisibility: Only p, q, r, 67°, 42° and parallel markers are visible in the question.

answer.short:
$p=42^\circ$ (alternate angles on parallel lines).

$q=67^\circ$ (alternate angles on parallel lines).

$r=71^\circ$ (angles on a straight line).
answer.worked:
$p=42^\circ$ (alternate angles on parallel lines).

$q=67^\circ$ (alternate angles on parallel lines).

Angles on a straight line:
$$\begin{align*}q+r+p&=180\\67+r+42&=180\\r+109&=180\\r&=71\end{align*}$$
$r=71^\circ$.
